svg.metadata: {"story":"Ruth","act":5,"chapter":"Ch.5 · Threshing Floor","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Ruth goes to the threshing floor at Naomi's word, uncovers Boaz's feet, and asks him to spread his cloak over her.
